title: Incoherent
summary: INCOHE'RENT, adjective [in and coherent.] 1. Wanting cohesion; loose; unconnected; not fixed to each other; applied to material substances. 2. Wanting coherence or agreement; incongruous; inconsistent

inlines.v: INCOHE'RENT, adjective [in and coherent.] 1. Wanting cohesion; loose; unconnected; not fixed to each other; applied to material substances. 2. Wanting coherence or agreement; incongruous; inconsistent; having no dependence of one part on another; as, the thoughts of a dreaming man, and the language of a madman, are incoherent
